title: Delivery Tariff and Mill Running Order, Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes
content:
Delivery charges, the notice an order takes, the schedule a programme is put on and the place it holds in the mill's running order are set for the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes as follows.

| Programme | Charge for delivering one load | Tons at or above which delivery is carried at no charge | Charge for a delivery taken outside mill hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | $65.00 | 4.00 | $95.00 |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | $65.00 | 4.00 | $95.00 |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | $65.00 | 6.00 | $95.00 |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | $0.00 | 10.00 | $95.00 |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | $0.00 | 12.00 | $0.00 |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | $65.00 | 6.00 | $125.00 |

| Programme | How often the mill is scheduled to deliver | Business days of notice an order takes | Place in the mill's running order |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bagged Feed Cash Account | on demand | 2 | the standard queue |
| Bulk Delivered Feed Account | every second week | 2 | the standard queue |
| Custom Mix Ration Program | weekly | 3 | the standard queue |
| Contracted Ingredient Program | weekly | 3 | the priority queue |
| Full Nutrition Partner Program | weekly | 2 | first in the queue |
| Medicated Feed VFD Program | weekly | 5 | the priority queue |

## Reading the two tables together

Three of the six programmes carry a sixty-five dollar charge for a load, the Contracted Ingredient Program and the Full Nutrition Partner Program carry none, and the Medicated Feed VFD Program alone carries a hundred and twenty-five dollars for a delivery taken outside mill hours where the others carry ninety-five and the Full Nutrition Partner Program nothing. The tons at which delivery is carried free rise with the programme, from four on the Bagged Feed Cash Account and the Bulk Delivered Feed Account to twelve on the Full Nutrition Partner Program.

Notice is shortest at two business days on the Bagged Feed Cash Account, the Bulk Delivered Feed Account and the Full Nutrition Partner Program, three on the Custom Mix Ration Program and the Contracted Ingredient Program, and longest at five on the Medicated Feed VFD Program. Two programmes stand ahead of the standard queue, the Contracted Ingredient Program and the Medicated Feed VFD Program in the priority queue, and the Full Nutrition Partner Program first in the queue.

*Hypothetical.* A load of ten tons delivered on a Contracted Ingredient Program reaches the ten tons the schedule sets for that programme; a load of nine tons and a half on the same programme does not.
